rationale: Adds a Pulp-owned configure-time guard for the Windows ARM64EC Skia/Dawn provider's MSVC STL/CRT toolset contract. It reads existing provider metadata and COFF members, rejects an older consumer before link, and documents the existing Windows packaging acceptance path. The change does not alter design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority and introduces no generic renderer implementation or Vellum dependency.
